project_type: Full-stack SaaS: React + Vite frontend, FastAPI backend, Google Gemini AI integration
build_system: npm for frontend (Vite), pip for backend (FastAPI/uvicorn)
test_framework: pytest for backend, vitest for frontend (can be added if needed)
build_command: Frontend: npm run build; Backend: no compile step, runs directly
test_command: Backend: pytest; Frontend: npm run test (if added)
verification_instructions: Backend: run pytest tests, verify FastAPI starts on 8000, check SQLite database seeding. Frontend: npm run dev, open http://localhost:5173, verify all pages load and API calls work.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Frontend: dist/ from Vite build. Backend: SQLite database (agentshield.db) is generated on first run with seeded data. Both can be regenerated from source.
environment_constraints: Requires GEMINI_API_KEY for AI integration (optional, mock mode works without it). Backend runs on 8000, frontend dev on 5173. Use absolute paths in backend code; relative paths go to parent workspace.
contribution_requirements: Modular structure: separate concerns (agent, security, tools, routes, models, database). All tool calls must route through security gateway. No hardcoded fake metrics in frontend — all data from backend. Seeded demo data clearly labeled. Policy enforcement server-side only.
key_patterns: Backend: FastAPI route handlers with /api prefix, Pydantic models for validation, SQLAlchemy ORM, service layer separation (agent_service, gateway, policy_engine, etc.). Frontend: React components in src/components, pages in src/pages, API calls via services, TypeScript for type safety, Tailwind for styling.
relevant_files: frontend/src/pages/ — Overview, Playground, Gateway, Threats, Logs, Policies, Settings, AttackLab
frontend/src/services/api.ts — axios wrapper for API calls
directory_structure: backend/: main.py (entry), agent/ (Gemini + tool registry), security/ (gateway + detectors), tools/ (simulated tools), routes/ (API endpoints), models/ (Pydantic), database/ (SQLAlchemy + seed), tests/ (pytest). frontend/: src/ with App.tsx, pages/, components/, services/, types/, public/ (static), vite.config.ts, package.json. Root: README.md, .env.example, .gitignore, requirements.txt (backend).
